# The travel of
# usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_income_in_canadian_dollars.txt edited
# with `--strategy update` into 200.00 USD charged to the card, after 200.00
# USD was paid onto the card owing nothing, stating no guid.
#
# The card holds a credit of 200.00, so the charge spends what it held, which
# draws down a cost basis of dollars held, and an edit runs none of the checks
# a disposal meets. So it is refused and sent to delete-and-import.
#
# The payment onto the card is imported first, as a block of its own; the edit
# is ..._travel_charged_to_the_card.txt.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-10 * "Pay 200.00 USD onto the card from C"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C -200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-270.00"
	Liabilities:USD Card 200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "270.00"
